title: ajuga vulgaris var. breviproles
intro: Ajuga vulgaris var. breviproles, commonly known as Bugleweed, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing anxiety and stress, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bugleweed include its sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Bugleweed include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
